### What if your Mac’s notch could actually be useful? 🦤

I built NotchDodo because I kept thinking about one simple question: [...] Why should the Mac s notch just take up space?

So I built 14 small tools around it to make the notch part of my everyday workflow - quick access, useful utilities, and a little personality.

Dashboard the home page, with the other tools condensed into cells. Cannot be switched off.

Today your calendar, with a one-click Join for Zoom, Meet and Teams.

Tasks a local to-do list with a quick-add field.

Reminders your Apple Reminders, tickable from the notch.

Notes multiple notes that save as you type.

Pomodoro work, break, long break, quick timer, custom and a stopwatch.

AI Usage live tokens, cost, burn rate and the five-hour window for Claude Code and Codex.

Calculator maths, unit conversion and currency.

Music Now Playing for Apple Music and the Spotify desktop app. [...] Shelf drag files onto the notch, drag them out or AirDrop them. Browser downloads land here.

Screen Time where your day went, by app and by category.

System Analytics CPU, memory, storage, network, battery and free disk.

Mirror a camera check before a call.

Support & Feedback send a message without leaving the app.

NotchDodo turns your MacBook notch into a productive workspace. With one hover above the menu bar, you get instant access to 14 powerful tools: [...] Dashboard — Eight widgets showing what matters right now
 Pomodoro — A watch-style timer that lives in the notch
 AI Usage — Track Claude Code and Codex token costs locally
 Today — Calendar events with one-click join for Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex and FaceTime
 Reminders — Apple Reminders synced through iCloud
 Tasks — Quick to-do list kept locally on your Mac
 Notes — Auto-saving notes with first-line-as-title
 Music — Now Playing controls for Apple Music and Spotify desktop
 Shelf — File holding area with drag-and-drop support
 Calculator — Natural math with percentages and unit conversions
 Screen Time — Track which apps had your day
 System Analytics — Machine stats at a glance
 Mirror — Quick camera check before calls
 Support & Feedback — Talk to the team from the notch [...] logo
